_comment: settings.theme for the Servicing workbook. NPL Portfolio Dashboard v2's theme (sizes, spacing, table style) with Brocc's brand: font FFF Acid Grotesk (the name Sigma knows it by, as the NPL workbook uses it) and the palette of work/servicing/design/reference/Example Slides.potx (deep green #012E26, cream, periwinkle, violet). Series colours follow list order: charts list the benchmark first (violet, drawn behind) and actuals second (green, in front). Green and red keep their meaning: ahead and behind.
